sources.title: [PATCH v6 0/2] media: i2c: Add Samsung S5KJN5 image sensor

claims.claim: This series adds support for the Samsung S5KJN5, a 50 MP 10-bit RAW MIPI CSI-2 image sensor. This is implemented as a separate driver rather than extending the existing s5kjn1 driver. Although both sensors belong to the same family, they are different parts with different register maps and power supplies. Combining support for both devices in a single driver would result in very little shared code while introducing separate initialization and control paths, so keeping them as independent drivers

sources.title: [PATCH 3/3] media: mali-c55: Keep ISP powered while IRQ wake is armed

claims.claim: System suspend enables IRQ wake and then calls pm_runtime_force_suspend(). For an active ISP this asserts its resets and disables its clocks, so it can no longer generate frame interrupts. An already runtime-suspended ISP is left powered off as well. Take a runtime PM reference before arming IRQ wake and retain it until resume. This powers up an idle ISP and keeps an active ISP's configuration intact. sources.title: [PATCH v2] media: rcar-isp: ispcore: Fix inconsistent step sizes

claims.claim: `risp_io_{input,capture}_enum_framesizes()` sets the horizontal and vertical step size to 2. However, `risp_io_{input,capture}_try_format()` passes 2 to `v4l_bound_align_image()`, which corresponds to a step size of 2^2 = 4. So move these constants into macros to avoid the repetition, and with that, use 4 as the step size everywhere. Fixes: 2151350f60d1 ("media: rcar-isp: Add support for ISPCORE") Signed-off-by: Barnabás Pőcze <barnabas.pocze+renesas@ideasonboard.com> Reviewed-by: Niklas Söderlu
